teaser.en: Children hunt its masses of tiny white berries, while their parents cut its twigs to build granaries and fish traps.
teaser.sw: Watoto huwinda matunda yake madogo meupe yaliyosongamana, huku wazazi wao wakikata vitawi vyake kujenga vihenge na kutengeneza madema ya samaki.
teaser.dg: Ana nkuhendza matunda manji madide mereru ga chitsaka chihi, na avyazi ao nkukata maphungoge kudzengera vitsaga na kuhenda migbwono.

summary.en: *Mkpwamba* is the white-berry bush, a much-branched shrub covered in small white berries. Its fruit feeds children, its twigs build houses, granaries and fish traps, and its root bark is used against malaria.
summary.sw: *Mkpwamba* ni mkwamba, kichaka chenye matawi mengi kilichofunikwa na matunda madogo meupe. Matunda yake huwalisha watoto, vitawi vyake hujenga nyumba, vihenge na madema ya samaki, na gome la mizizi yake hutumika dhidi ya malaria.
summary.dg: *Mkpwamba* ni *white-berry bush* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka chenye panda nyinji chinachobwiningizwa ni matunda madide mereru. Matundage ganarisa ana, maphungoge nkuhumirwa kudzengera nyumba na vitsaga na kuhenda migbwono, na gopha ra miziye nkuhumirwa kpwa homa (malaria).

about.en: *Mkpwamba* is a much-branched shrub, usually 1 to 3 m tall, with red-brown stems and small, neat leaves. In fruit it is covered in masses of small white berries, so many that the bush can look dusted with snow.
about.sw: *Mkpwamba* ni kichaka chenye matawi mengi, kwa kawaida chenye urefu wa m 1 hadi 3, mashina ya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu na majani madogo nadhifu. Kinapozaa hufunikwa na matunda madogo meupe yaliyosongamana, mengi kiasi kwamba kichaka kinaweza kuonekana kama kimenyunyiziwa theluji.
about.dg: *Mkpwamba* ni chitsaka chenye panda nyinji, kpwa kawaida chire cha mita 1 hadi 3, chenye mihi ya rangi ya kundu na dongo na makodza madide manono. Chichikala na matunda, chinabwiningizwa ni matunda madide mereru manji sana, hata chitsaka chosi chinaonekana dza chikamwagirwa theluji.

where.en: It is common throughout the coast, in bushland, thicket and fallow fields. The white berries make it easy to spot.
where.sw: Ni cha kawaida pwani kote, vichakani, katika vichaka vizito na mashamba yaliyoachwa. Matunda yake meupe hukifanya kiwe rahisi kukiona.
where.dg: Ni chitsaka cha kawaida kosi pwani, weruni, vitsakani na kpwenye minda iriyorichwa. Matunda mereru ganahenda chikale rahisi kuchiona.

uses.en: The white berries are eaten by children. The long, thin twigs are used in building houses and granaries and in making fish traps. The Digo of Diani boil the root bark to treat malaria.
uses.sw: Matunda meupe huliwa na watoto. Vitawi virefu vyembamba hutumika katika ujenzi wa nyumba na vihenge na katika kutengeneza madema ya samaki. Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha gome la mizizi kutibu malaria.
uses.dg: Matunda mereru nkuriwa ni ana. Maphungo mare na membamba nkuhumirwa kudzengera nyumba na vitsaga na kuhenda migbwono. Adigo a Diani nkuchemusha gopha ra mizi kuhenda dawa ya homa (malaria).

culture.en: The Digo distinguish a 'female' and a 'male' *mkpwamba*. This white-fruited plant is the female; the male is a related shrub, *Phyllanthus reticulatus*.
culture.sw: Wadigo wanatofautisha *mkpwamba* 'jike' na 'dume'. Mmea huu wenye matunda meupe ndio jike; dume ni kichaka jamaa, *Phyllanthus reticulatus*.
culture.dg: Adigo anatafwautisha *mkpwamba* 'mchetu' na *mkpwamba* 'mlume'. Mmea uhu wa matunda mereru ndio mchetu; mlume ni chitsaka chanjina cha phephi, *Phyllanthus reticulatus*.

names.en: Pakia records *mkpwamba*, with the forms *mkpwamba mchetu* and *mkpwamba vitu*, and also *mkambakamba*. ICRAF's handbook writes *mkwamba*, which is also the Swahili, Giriama and Chonyi name; Swahili also has *mteja*. In English it is the white-berry bush.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *mkpwamba*, pamoja na maumbo *mkpwamba mchetu* na *mkpwamba vitu*, na pia *mkambakamba*. Kitabu cha ICRAF kinaandika *mkwamba*, ambalo pia ni jina la Kiswahili, Kigiriama na Kichonyi; Kiswahili kina pia *mteja*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *white-berry bush*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkpwamba*, na madzina *mkpwamba mchetu* na *mkpwamba vitu*, na piya *mkambakamba*. Chitabu cha ICRAF chinaandika *mkwamba*, ambaro piya ni dzina ra Chiswahili, Chigiriama na Chichonyi; Chiswahili piya china *mteja*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *white-berry bush*.

reason.en: Tassel berry, same family and also has edible berries
reason.sw: *Mdanga tsongo* (*tassel berry*), wa familia moja na pia una matunda yanayoliwa
reason.dg: *Mdanga tsongo*, jamii iyo hiyo, piya una matunda ganayoriwa

reason.en: Bush shrub whose root bark is also boiled for malaria
reason.sw: Kichaka cha vichakani ambacho gome la mizizi yake pia huchemshwa kwa ajili ya malaria
reason.dg: Chitsaka cha weruni ambacho gopha ra miziye piya nkuchemuswa kpwa homa (malaria)

reason.en: Another bush shrub with fruit eaten by children
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha vichakani ambacho matunda yake huliwa na watoto
reason.dg: Chitsaka chanjina cha weruni ambacho matundage nkuriwa ni ana
